federal_note: Federal programs (DTC, Child Disability Benefit, RDSP, Canada Child Benefit, Canada Disability Benefit for adults, Jordan's Principle, Inuit Child First) apply everywhere; see data/programs.json.

programs.name: Preschool Autism Program
programs.gov: New Brunswick (Education and Early Childhood Development)
programs.what: Free autism therapy for young kids before they start school. It uses ABA (a therapy that teaches skills step by step). It costs you nothing.
who: Your child is 0 to 5, lives in NB, and has an autism diagnosis.
Your child has not started school.
steps: The doctor or psychologist who diagnosed your child sends a form to the province.
The province calls you to sign up. Questions: 1-844-377-3819.
programs.nickname: NB free autism therapy for preschoolers

programs.name: Family Supports for Children with Disabilities
programs.what: Help so you can care for your child at home. This can include respite (a break for you) and child care.
programs.amount: No fixed amount published; check the official page.
who: Your child has a disability and lives in NB.
links: GNB: Family supports for children with disabilities
programs.nickname: NB help for kids with disabilities

programs.name: Disability Support Program (adults)
programs.what: Help for adults with a long-term disability, like personal care, respite, and rides. You may pay part, based on income. Savings are not counted.
programs.amount: No fixed amount published; check the official page.
who: Adults 19 to 64 with a long-term disability.
programs.nickname: NB help for adults with disabilities

programs.name: Jordan's Principle (First Nations children)
programs.what: Money from the federal government for First Nations kids. It can pay for therapy, respite (a break for you while someone else cares for your child), talking devices, and equipment. It works in every province, on or off reserve.
programs.amount: Case by case; no fixed amount.
who: Your child is First Nations and under 19
steps: Call 1-855-572-4453. The line is open 24 hours a day.
Or apply online on the Indigenous Services Canada website.
programs.nickname: Jordan's Principle (help for First Nations kids)
